title: HackerNews Top Stories
description: Fetches the current top 30 stories from Hacker News using the official Firebase API. Returns titles, scores, authors, URLs, and comment counts. No API key required.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timezone

# HackerNews Official API (Firebase) - no auth, no rate limit
# https://github.com/HackerNews/API
BASE = 'https://hacker-news.firebaseio.com/v0'

# Get top story IDs (returns ~500, we take top 30)
resp = requests.get(f'{BASE}/topstories.json', timeout=30)
resp.raise_for_status()
story_ids = resp.json()[:30]

rows = []
for sid in story_ids:
    item_resp = requests.get(f'{BASE}/item/{sid}.json', timeout=15)
    if item_resp.status_code != 200:
        continue
    item = item_resp.json()
    if not item:
        continue

    rows.append({
        'story_id': item.get('id', ''),
        'title': item.get('title', ''),
        'url': item.get('url', ''),
        'author': item.get('by', ''),
        'score': item.get('score', 0),
        'comment_count': item.get('descendants', 0),
        'type': item.get('type', 'story'),
        '_epoch': item.get('time', int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())),
    })

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
